'''2005 New York Open Qualifier''' (announced as the "Winter Break NYC Open Qualifier") was a Star Wars CCG Open Qualifier for the [[2005 World Championship]], played on Saturday 8 January 2005 at Neutral Ground, 122 West 26th Street, New York City.<ref name="pcf-4273-58673">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=58673#58673 January 8th 2005. Winter Break NYC Open Qualifier], Scott Lingrell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (20 December 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050224204918/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=58673%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> [[Scott Lingrell]] announced it,<ref name="pcf-4273-58673" /> and [[Jason Robinette]], a [[Players Committee advocates|Players Committee advocate]], directed it. Fifteen players from six states took part; heavy rain made some players cancel their trips. [[Brian Hollingworth]] finished first in the standings, and Scott Lingrell and [[Jarad Konsker]] qualified for Day 2 of the World Championship.<ref name="pcf-4273-59872">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59872#59872 January 8th 2005. Winter Break NYC Open Qualifier], Scott Lingrell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (11 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050224204918/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=58673%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pc-events05">[http://swccgpc.com/events.htm 2004/2005 Events: SWCCG 2005 Worlds Qualifiers Listing], swccgpc.com (updated 27 June 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050828001521/http://swccgpc.com:80/events.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS8]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Neutral Ground, 122 West 26th Street, 4th Floor (between 6th and 7th Avenues), New York, New York. Neutral Ground was a Decipher Platinum Preferred Retailer.<ref name="pcf-4273-58673" />
* '''Dates:''' 8 January 2005, 12 noon<ref name="pcf-4273-58673" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Jason Robinette]]<ref name="pcf-4273-59872" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $10<ref name="pcf-4273-58970">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=58970#58970 January 8th 2005. Winter Break NYC Open Qualifier], Scott Lingrell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (27 December 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050224204918/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=58673%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Structure:''' constructed, six games of Swiss, with the top two to play a final confrontation<ref name="pcf-4273-58970" /><ref name="pcf-4273-59501">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59501#59501 January 8th 2005. Winter Break NYC Open Qualifier], Scott Lingrell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (5 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050224204918/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=58673%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Players:''' 15<ref name="pcf-4273-59872" />
* '''Qualified for Day 2:''' [[Scott Lingrell]], [[Jarad Konsker]]<ref name="pcf-4273-59872" /><ref name="pc-events05" />

== Organization ==

Tony of Neutral Ground bought the Players Committee's Ultimate Package of prizes: the design of a future [[Virtual cards|Virtual Card]] for the winner, six uncut sheets, two booster boxes, eight tournament foils, posters and pins. Further prizes were bought from Neutral Ground with the entry fees, every player was to receive a free T-shirt, and the top two were to receive byes into the 2005 World Championship. A Texas Hold'em game was planned for after the tournament.<ref name="pcf-4273-58970" /> Lingrell expected about 30 players and had 25 confirmed reservations five days before the event.<ref name="pcf-4273-59387">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59387#59387 January 8th 2005. Winter Break NYC Open Qualifier], Scott Lingrell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (3 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050224204918/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=58673%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

Lingrell's guide to the event asked players to arrive with Players Committee decklists already filled out. It also told them that a recently updated Premium Virtual Card release had a number of editing errors: the cards were meant to be identical to the original Virtual Card sets, so any differences were to be ignored while they were corrected.<ref name="pcf-4273-59501" />

== Results ==

Final standings as posted by Lingrell, with each player's two decks and their records in the order he posted them.<ref name="pcf-4273-59872" /> Lingrell labelled each player's first deck Light Side and the second Dark Side. Michael Pistone posted that his Throne Room Mains went 3–0 and his Maul Drain Deck 2–1.<ref name="pcf-4273-60259">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60259#60259 January 8th 2005. Winter Break NYC Open Qualifier], Michael Pistone, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (19 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050224204918/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=58673%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
